title: Alex Staples
summary: Senior front-end engineer with over 10 years of experience building fast, real-time web apps in React and TypeScript, and AI-assisted tooling for developers.

trivelta.summary: Senior front-end web engineer on a white-label iGaming platform. Core front-end contributor to the next-generation sportsbook, and led front-end localization that opened the web app to Spanish-only clients. Led performance work that cut initial load by about 30% and smoothed rendering on lower-end devices, and reduced AWS costs by optimizing data loading and caching. The team's go-to engineer for AI-assisted development, from introducing subagent delegation to reworking the company's shared agent configuration.
bullets: Core front-end contributor to the next-generation sportsbook, built in Next.js, React and TypeScript
Led a performance effort that cut initial load by about 30% and smoothed rendering
Led AWS cost reduction across the web app, especially the sportsbook, by optimizing data loading and caching
Led front-end localization for the web app, opening it to Spanish-only clients
Go-to engineer for AI-assisted development; championed subagent delegation and parallel agents

multitudeInsights.summary: Senior front-end developer for BLTN, a crime pattern analysis platform for law enforcement agencies, built with React and Next.js in TypeScript. Developed the complete UI for the contact management feature, giving agencies control over who could access their posts, and built the notification settings dashboard agencies needed in time for the Boston Marathon. Also added schema validation to contact management and other features, and kept the app responsive for officers in the field on limited bandwidth.
bullets: Developed features for BLTN, a crime pattern analysis platform for law enforcement agencies
Built the complete UI for contact management, which controls access to agency posts
Added schema validation to contact management and other features
Built the notification settings dashboard agencies needed in time for the Boston Marathon
Held CJIS certification to work with protected crime data

wasabi.summary: Senior engineer on Wasabi's application development team, building the customer-facing Wasabi Console for cloud object storage and the internal tools used to run its datacenters. Designed core front-end architecture across both, and was a major contributor to the shared UI library behind at least five of the company's apps, from tables and dashboards to app initialization and error handling. Managed release lifecycles and CI/CD for the team, led efforts to modernize older codebases, and mentored junior developers.
bullets: Designed front-end architecture for the customer-facing Wasabi Console and ops tools
Major contributor to a shared UI library used across 5+ of the company's apps
Managed release lifecycles and CI/CD for the team with Docker and GitHub Actions
Led efforts to modernize older codebases with open source libraries
Mentored junior developers and interviewed candidates for the applications team

motifSoftware.summary: Independent contractor building React front ends for clients in the greater Boston area, across digital cytology, eCommerce, and sales analytics. Built the front end for a digital cytology product on a .NET backend, and wrote the technical documentation it needed for HIPAA compliance. Also built front-end features for a sporting goods eCommerce site on EPiServer CMS.
bullets: Built React front ends for contract clients in cytology, eCommerce and sales analytics
Wrote the technical documentation a cytology product needed to meet HIPAA requirements
Built front-end features for a sporting goods eCommerce site on EPiServer CMS and .NET

tandemSeven.summary: Front-end developer at a UX consulting firm, doing React and Node.js development on client projects. Built new forms and ensured accessibility compliance for a major U.S. airline's customer support site, and built cart, user settings, and geolocation features for a multimedia company's new eCommerce site, including work with internationalization APIs. Also researched web development standards and best practices for the team, and demoed functional reactive programming with Elm.
bullets: Built cart, user settings and geolocation features for a multimedia company's eCommerce site
Built accessible new forms for a major U.S. airline's customer support site
Researched web development standards and best practices for the team

ca.summary: Joined as an intern and grew into a full-stack role on CA Performance Management, an enterprise network performance monitoring product. Wrote a Python test suite and search tool for the logic behind its device metrics, was a key front-end contributor to an OData query builder, then moved on to the product's main Java web interface and backend services, patching customer-reported issues on the sustaining team. Also modernized internal tooling with React and Electron, and led a hackathon team that built a natural language chat interface for querying network metrics.
bullets: Built a Python test suite and search tool for the logic behind network device metrics
Key front-end contributor to an OData query builder in JavaScript and Ext JS
Worked on the product's Java web interface and backend, patching customer-reported issues
Led a hackathon team that built a natural language chat interface for querying network metrics
